what: Option B step 1 FAILED TWICE, and the two failures together show the measurement cannot fit inside the travel budget at linear 400. A speed check then eliminated the slow-down escape route by measurement.
verdict: BOTH RUN-1 ATTEMPTS FAIL against docs/phase2-feedforward-measurement-predeclared-20260829.md. tau is NOT measured. Run 2 (+180) was never dispatched.

attempt_1.label: baseline 1500 / step 2500 / settle 6000, +120
attempt_1.why_it_failed: ZERO informative intervals in baseline AND step -- every chord before settle fell below the 0.15 m floor (0.0277, 0.1387, 0.0456, 0.1177 m). The mower was still accelerating: 0.139 m/s through baseline+step against 0.265 m/s by settle. omega_step is null, so tau could not be computed at all.
attempt_1.my_error: I trimmed baseline_ms 2000 -> 1500 to fund the longer settle, and removed the margin that let earlier runs get informative chords before the step. That is a predeclaration error, not a property of the mower.
attempt_1.what_DID_work: The 6 s settle solved the censoring: rates ran -6.696 -> +2.157 -> +0.724 -> -0.426 deg/s and the last two agreed to 1.15 deg/s, inside the 1.5 deg/s criterion. The course went flat.

attempt_2.label: baseline 3000 / step 2500 / settle 4500, +120
attempt_2.why_it_failed: Criterion 2 requires the last two settle rates to agree within 1.5 deg/s. They were -0.067 and -2.648 -- 2.58 deg/s apart. The course never went flat.
attempt_2.and_the_number_is_untrustworthy: omega was taken from the step phase at -1.839 deg/s while the ACTUAL peak of -8.680 deg/s arrived ~2 s AFTER the command ended, inside settle. tau = 13.38/1.84 = 7.28 s is inflated by a denominator that measured the ramp rather than steady rotation. It is NOT quoted.
attempt_2.what_improved: Informative intervals in all three phases (2/2/4) where attempt 1 had 0/0/5.

the_structural_finding.claim: At linear 400 the measurement cannot fit inside the travel budget it must respect.
the_structural_finding.arithmetic: Onset lag ~2 s means a step must run ~5-6 s to reach steady rotation; settle needs ~5 s to flatten; baseline needs ~3 s to reach speed. ~14 s total. At the steady ~0.26 m/s that is ~3.4 m of path, plus 0.50 m stop overshoot = ~3.9-4.1 m of required clearance. max_travel_m is schema-capped at 3.00 and linear_speed is pinned at 400.
the_structural_finding.consequence: This is not a tuning problem. The exposure bound and the measurement requirement genuinely conflict, and one of them has to move.

speed_check_2026_08_30.purpose: Test whether driving SLOWER buys enough window time inside the same 3.00 m cap, since slower means more seconds per metre.
speed_check_2026_08_30.method: raw_pymammotion_motion_probe, 4000 ms, angular 0, motion_refresh_interval_ms 200, travel guard disabled (the clock bounds travel to ~1.5 m including stop, in a spot with ~5 m of clearance).
speed_check_2026_08_30.note_on_the_figures: These are AVERAGES over a 4 s window including the standstill ramp and stop overshoot, so they are lower than the ~0.26 m/s steady-state speed seen mid-run in the step probe's settle phase. Both numbers are directly comparable to each other, which is what the check needed.
speed_check_2026_08_30.result: ROUTE 2 IS ELIMINATED BY MEASUREMENT. At linear 300 the mower covers 0.116 m per ~1 s position update, BELOW the 0.15 m informativeness floor, so the heading cannot be read at all. No slower speed works -- it only gets worse.
speed_check_2026_08_30.my_extrapolation_was_wrong: I estimated linear 300 at 0.195 m/s from a single measured point at 400. It is 0.116. A 25% cut in command produced a 39% cut in speed -- the relationship is NOT linear. This is the sparse-fit trap this project has hit before, avoided this time for the cost of a 10-second run.

defect_found_and_fixed.what: `maxsize=1` on position streams opened by the shared sampler and the distance-guarded probe wrapper.
defect_found_and_fixed.evidence: The first linear-300 speed check aborted at 413 ms with trip_reason `position_sequence_gap` and travel_at_trip_m 0.0 -- a healthy feed read through a one-deep, latest-wins queue.
defect_found_and_fixed.history: The comment on _SAFETY_POSITION_STREAM_MAXSIZE has warned since 2026-08-27 that this exact value structurally guarantees a false position_sequence_gap. The beta80 fix reached the two lease wrappers and missed BOTH of these call sites.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Both now use _SAFETY_POSITION_STREAM_MAXSIZE (64), pinned by a source-scan test because the failure is a literal that a new call site would reintroduce silently.
defect_found_and_fixed.status: FIXED, tested, NOT DEPLOYED -- the host runs beta86.

incidental_reach_data.note: A safe refusal, not a landing. Recorded because a 2.2 m leg exhausting the turn budget is the shortest such stop on record.

safety.all_runs: 15/15 gates before each step-probe dispatch; 13/13 before each reposition; every stop confirmed; gate disarmed and verified from the live API AND RAW core.config_entries after each session
safety.corridor: 7.2 m square re-scanned and re-verified at the live position before each run; a corridor is never reused across a run that moves the mower

what_is_still_unmeasured: tau. Q2 remains open. Run 2 (+180), which would answer whether omega scales with command, was never dispatched.
